usageNotes: Returns the top-level HA directory index listing the available HA sub-resources (e.g. groups, resources, status). Use this as a discovery call to enumerate the HA namespace before drilling into specific sub-endpoints. Requires Sys.Audit on / — typically granted to cluster admins.

examples.summary: List available HA sub-resources on the cluster

tips: The returned 'id' values correspond directly to child API paths under /cluster/ha (e.g. 'groups', 'resources', 'status').
HA is only meaningful when the cluster has at least two nodes and quorum is healthy; the directory index itself will succeed regardless of quorum state.
